## 10. Prime numbers under the full operational lens

Let

\[
p_1=2,p_2=3,p_3=5,\ldots
\]

be the increasing prime sequence.

For every prime \(p\), the standard rank

\[
r=\pi(p)
\]

is a derived arithmetic relation, and

\[
r\longleftrightarrow p_r
\]

is an exact inverse pair as a mathematical definition. This does not make
prime certification or computation free.

For width \(k\), define

\[
W_{r,k}=(p_r,p_{r+1},\ldots,p_{r+k-1}).
\]

The operations

\[
\begin{aligned}
S_+(r,k)&=(r+1,k),\\
S_-(r,k)&=(r-1,k),\\
E(r,k)&=(r,k+1),\\
D(r,k)&=(r,k-1)
\end{aligned}
\]

select an operational chart already grounded in prime arithmetic.
